name: axiru-gate
description: One payment gate for every agent platform: Paperclip, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and any MCP host.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @axiru/gate-core && npm run build -w @axiru/gate-mcp && npm run build -w @axiru/paperclip-plugin-gate && npm run build -w @axiru/openshell-middleware
scripts.test: npm run test -w @axiru/gate-core && npm run test -w @axiru/gate-mcp && npm run test -w @axiru/openshell-middleware
